description: Check up to 50,000 addresses in the background. Returns 202 with a job `id`; poll email_verify_job_get. A slow or greylisting server is retried about 5, 15 and 30 minutes later, free. Each valid or invalid result costs $0.003 as it is checked; catch-all and unknown are free. An optional https `callback_url` gets one signed POST when the job completes (verify with the returned `secret`). At most 5 jobs run at once per account.

callback_url.description: An https URL to POST to when the job completes.

monitor_days.description: Check the whole list again this many days after each run, billing each definite result again; the callback reports what changed.

sample.description: Check only a random sample of this many addresses; the job then reports estimated shares for the whole list.

name: email_verify_job_create
title: Start Email Verification Job
